name: Sexy Cabin Murder Man
source:
A short game about a man who kidnaps you and brings you to his cabin in the woods. He just wants a wife. Desperately. If you're not a woman? It's okay. You still get to be his wife :3 Dresses and all!

[From [url=https://krystalwithakay.itch.io/sexy-cabin-murder-man]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款关于一个男人绑架你并将你带到他在树林里的小屋的短游戏。他只是想要一个妻子。绝望地。如果你不是女人？没关系。你仍然可以成为他的妻子：3件衣服等等！

[来自[url=https://krystalwithakay.itch.io/sexy-cabin-murder-man]Itch.io[/url]]
